questions.answerDescription: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) executes instructions and is often called the brain of the computer.
questions.hint: It is the "brain" of the computer.

questions.questionText: Which part of a computer displays visual output?
questions.answerDescription: The monitor is the output device that displays images and text.
questions.hint: You look at it to see the screen.

options: A named storage location that holds a value
questions.answerDescription: A variable is a named storage location used to hold a value that can change over time.
questions.hint: Its value can often change while a program runs.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of a "loop" in programming?
options: Repeating a block of code multiple times
questions.answerDescription: A loop repeats a block of code multiple times, often until a condition is met.
questions.hint: For and while loops are common examples.
